metadata.title: Searching for clues of past binary supermassive black hole mergers in nuclear star clusters

notes: No eligible stars. The only individually named central object is Sgr A*, explicitly described as the Milky Way's 4.3×10^6 M⊙ SMBH rather than a star, and it is not assessed as Galactic unbound (T:p1-b13). The paper's hypervelocity stars are simulated N-body particles reported only in aggregate counts for each merger model, without individual stellar identifiers (T:p9-b7); they are not identified present-day Milky Way unbound candidates.
